title: Order, stages and demand
description: Select same-parity arguments, trace a lazy pipeline, evaluate ordered coefficients, count source pulls and preview original adjacent rises.

learned: Preserve relative order and repeated occurrences during selection.
Trace requests through source, predicate, mapping and output events.
Combine ordered coefficients from the highest term downward.
Count actual yielded inputs rather than output length.
recap.invariant: The recorded prefix or suffix contains exactly the values already processed under its stated ordering rule.
recap.complexity: For a finite sequence of n coefficients, the polynomial algorithm performs n multiply-add steps. A lazy pipeline producing k results after examining p inputs calls its predicate p times and transforms k accepted inputs. Counts exclude drawing; arithmetic, callback and source costs are separate.
recap.common_mistake: Reading one value too many after filling a prefix, or comparing a reading with an earlier retained result instead of its original predecessor.
in_real_programs: Python map and filter return iterators; a generator suspends at yield and resumes on demand. An exhausted iterator does not replay itself.

retrieval.question: Module 4: what should remain stable if the representation of a sequence changes?
retrieval.answer: Its public meaning and operation contracts; clients should not depend on storage details.
